summary: This bill expands the experienced services program under the Food Security Act of 1985 to include assisting cooperative initiatives that improve higher education teaching programs, including paid work-based learning, at institutions of higher education.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the scope of the 'experienced services program' to include assisting cooperative initiatives for improving higher education teaching programs, including paid work-based learning. This expansion implies an increase in the activities supported by the program, which would likely lead to more government spending, though the bill does not specify appropriations.
